findings.summary: Runbook step 12's second --verify-admin cannot run as written from a fresh SSH login
findings.recommendation: Step 12 says to SSH in from the host and 'run the same command again': `bash deploy/soak/guest/guest-setup.sh --verify-admin`. A fresh SSH session starts in $HOME, not /opt/tangleclaw-soak, so the relative path fails; and admin mode refuses without SOAK_DHCP_SERVER (guest.conf defaults it empty), which a new session does not inherit. An operator then gets a non-zero exit that step 12's failure branch reads as 'renewal did not happen', which is the exact trigger for the static-address fallback. Write the command in full: `cd /opt/tangleclaw-soak && SOAK_DHCP_SERVER=<server> bash deploy/soak/guest/guest-setup.sh --verify-admin`. Scope: class, bounded: no step in this runbook sets SOAK_DHCP_SERVER at all, though step 11's setup mode and step 12's first invocation also need it; search the runbook for every guest-setup.sh admin/setup invocation and give SOAK_DHCP_SERVER one owner (an early export step next to SOAK_SHA).
findings.fix_cost: FIX is free WHERE THIS FINDING POINTS — every file it cites is non-judgeable, so an edit confined to those moves no coverage and buys no round. If the real correction lands elsewhere, price the actual batch with `cost-of-commit` first.
